title: Crispy {p} with {v}
steps: Press the {p} between towels under a weight for 15 minutes, then cube it and dust with a little cornstarch. Sear in a hot oiled wok or skillet 5 to 6 minutes, turning, until golden and crisp. Move to a plate.
Add the {spice} to the pan for 30 seconds, until fragrant. Return the {p}, pour in the {sauce} with a splash of rice vinegar, and toss until coated.
Serve the {p} with the {v} over the {s}, with crushed peanuts if you like.
tip: Use half the oil and let the vegetables fill most of the plate.
